comment: ACME Corp General Ledger transactions. Contains financial postings including expenses and revenue. Join to ACME_DEPARTMENTS on DEPARTMENT_CODE and ACME_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS on ACCOUNT_CODE.

Accounting period in MON-YYYY format, for example JAN-2025 or AUG-2025. Q1=JAN/FEB/MAR, Q2=APR/MAY/JUN, Q3=JUL/AUG/SEP, Q4=OCT/NOV/DEC. Query the data to determine available periods; do not assume a fixed range.
Transaction category. Common values include EXPENSE, REVENUE, ASSET, LIABILITY, and EQUITY. Use EXPENSE for cost or spending questions.
Department code for the transaction. Join to ACME_DEPARTMENTS.DEPARTMENT_CODE to get the department name.
Account code for the transaction. Join to ACME_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_CODE to get account name and account type.
For EXPENSE rows sum DEBIT_AMOUNT to calculate total expenses or spending.
Credit-side amount. Do not use this for expense totals unless the question explicitly asks about credits.
Department reference table for ACME Corp. Use to translate department codes into department names and organizational context.
Primary department code. Join to ACME_GL_TRANSACTIONS.DEPARTMENT_CODE.
Human-readable department name such as Finance
Chart of accounts reference table. Use to map account codes to account names and financial categories.
Primary account code. Join to ACME_GL_TRANSACTIONS.ACCOUNT_CODE.
Financial category such as EXPENSE or REVENUE.
Month-end close task tracking table. Use for close status
Close task status. Valid values include OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, and COMPLETE.
